usage: Vendor, loot, and stash. Account heroes carry its typed effects into fights while it is equipped (and attuned, when required).

srd.line: Armor (Any Medium or Heavy, Except Hide Armor), Uncommon
srd.text:
_Armor (Any Medium or Heavy, Except Hide Armor), Uncommon_

This suit of armor is reinforced with adamantine, one of the hardest substances in existence. While you're wearing it, any Critical Hit against you becomes a normal hit.
